name: Qingjing Lanshan Homestay
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Qingjing Lanshan Homestay?
address: No. 32 Panjiayuan, Xiantan Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 房間挺大的，也很衞生，老闆熱情，周邊環境也很安靜，適合自駕遊，給我們推薦的周邊的飯店，有個鋼琴飯店的，菜都很好吃，沒有踩坑，這裏蚊子多，一定要帶驅蚊液，最好是長褲，不然晚上出來玩，小腿慘不忍睹
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The room was large and very clean, the owner was warm, and the surroundings were quiet, so it suits a driving trip. He recommended restaurants nearby, including one with a piano, and the food was all good with no duds. There are a lot of mosquitoes here, so bring repellent and ideally long trousers, or your legs will be a sorry sight after an evening out.

comments.quote: 簡直超出我的預期，老闆的服務態度很好，給人一種很舒服的感覺，假期住山裡的民宿放鬆一下心情。 房間的設施和環境和圖片相似度很高 周邊的環境也很美，空氣清新，是假日與家人朋友一起度假的好選擇。
comments.author: Guest User
